title: Forward Security for Deleted Epoch Keys with Logarithmic Storage
summary: GGM1 supports secure deletion but has linear state growth under puncturing; logarithmic worst-case storage with forward security remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Can forward security for deleted epoch keys be achieved with $O(\log N)$ worst-case storage?

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptography concerning forward-secure interval schemes and their storage complexity.
parameters: N, the parameter in the worst-case storage bound
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether a forward-secure interval scheme for deleted epoch keys can achieve logarithmic worst-case storage.

citations.label: Group Key Progression: Strong Security for Shared Persistent Data

progress.summary: The source explicitly states that achieving forward security with logarithmic worst-case storage is not known and consequently is not supported in GGM2.
citation_labels: Matilda Backendal et al., Group Key Progression: Strong Security for Shared Persistent Data
